title: domain.stock — ledger arithmetic (M-003 core; HIGHEST RISK in S2)
scope: 5 public + 1 private function. apply_inward/apply_sale/apply_adjustment: SELECT FOR UPDATE on latest (design, grade) row, compute new running_balance, insert new ledger row, _recompute_forward if back-dated. closing_balance(as_of_date): O(1) lookup. opening_balance(month_first_day) = closing_balance(month_first_day - 1 day) per DS-004.

success_criteria.manual: Apply functions: locks acquired before read; inserted row has correct delta and running_balance. Back-dated insert triggers forward-recompute on later rows. closing_balance with no rows returns 0.
success_criteria.automated: TC-079..TC-087 all pass; TC-086 verifies back-date recompute; TC-087 verifies concurrent serialization.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: 5 public functions match LLD signatures; _recompute_forward is bounded by the (design, grade) window; no global state; pure Session-in, ledger_row-out.

checkout_prompt: 'domain.stock complete — 5 ledger functions with SELECT FOR UPDATE + back-date recompute. HIGHEST RISK file passed.'
